desc: Whether you love shooting targets with handguns, rifles or shotguns, load up your target stand with EZ-Aim™ paper targets featuring splash technology that flakes and crumbles upon impact. If you prefer, have some handgun fun with our bullseye shooting targets that work well both indoors and outside. Trap shooters will have a blast with the EZ-Aim™ Xcelerator Claymaster target thrower. Keep your skills sharp and hit the range with self healers, paper targets, and throwers from EZ-Aim™ by Allen®.
